external_boundaries.content: Competent chamber and generic topical query, selected public content ID, public page metadata and official-source URLs; no client identifiers or case narrative
controls: Use generic topical searches without names, tax codes, VAT numbers, contact details, addresses, or case narrative.
Keep the public browser flow read-only and do not export cookies or use login, contact, assistance, upload, or submission routes.
A human selects the relevant SARI content before it is registered.
external_boundaries.destination: Public SARI, Registro Imprese, DIRE, chamber, INPS, INAIL, SUAP, and IVASS sources relevant to the case; for CH-GE, Geneva registry, Zefix and Fedlex public sources
external_boundaries.purpose: Select current official guidance and record its provenance

external_boundaries.content: Generic topical query or selected card ID, tenant and expected chamber; public metadata and card response
controls: Require a separate written rights-holder permission reference; invoking the connector is the explicit network-route choice and creates no second approval identifier.
Allow only the exact HTTPS SARI host and path, reject redirects, cap results and bytes, and fetch at most one selected card.
Keep anonymous cookies in memory and never call login, support, upload, or submission routes.
external_boundaries.destination: Exact public SARI host and selected chamber tenant
external_boundaries.purpose: Search public metadata and fetch one human-selected SARI card through the conditional connector

external_boundaries.content: Pinned Hugging Face model repository and revision requests plus ordinary connection metadata; no case screenshots, extracted case content, or approval identifier are sent
controls: Disabled by default and enabled only when the user explicitly selects the --allow-ocr-model-download route.
The run records route selection and actual network use without treating an arbitrary identifier as authorization.
Only model weights cross the boundary; screenshot recognition remains local.
external_boundaries.purpose: Download missing OCR model weights before local recognition

external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.
external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow

classes.content: Case facts and local evidence; DIRE or SARI screenshots and OCR; dates and chamber; official-source passages and provenance; proposed classifications, recipient positions, filing steps, questions and review decisions. For CH-GE this also includes the actual Geneva registry, Swiss enterprise identifier and source-backed local registration steps; language does not select jurisdiction.
classes.purpose: Frame the case, apply current official guidance, and draft the professional-review practice plan

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

classes.content: Confirmed saved question, complete initial intake and plan, public schema and skill locations, and paths and hashes of only explicitly selected registered originals. Actual reads can place real case data and official-source evidence in the selected runtime model context. The complete case/plan/source proposal and stage receipt are model-visible; private unsent fields, whole previews and human source-selector choices remain app-private. Context is whole within 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes or refused, without truncation. Permission, navigation and a copied prompt do not prove any model read. These optional native model routes are OpenAI-specific; ordinary Cowork connected-file work remains independent. App-private metadata placement depends on actual installed-host handling and does not promise local-only model processing.
classes.purpose: Prepare the exact explicitly authorized registry question, source proposals and whole draft for separately confirmed human conservation

classes.content: Only the complete selected review item, exact run/review/item hashes and status reach the selected host model, whole within 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes or refused. Literal private reviewer drafts, public whole decision population, whole output records and opaque persistence authority remain app-private. Selected content is untrusted evidence; actual model reads and original/source verification are not proved by navigation or a copied prompt. These optional native model routes are OpenAI-specific; ordinary Cowork connected-file work remains independent. App-private metadata placement depends on actual installed-host handling and does not promise local-only model processing.
classes.purpose: Discuss one explicitly selected complete prepared registry review item before independent professional choices

classes.content: After explicit whole-history and renewed new-run/mandate confirmation, all physical predecessor output records are registered as new sources: intake, plan, official source metadata and any copied source passages, validation, checklist, SARI question, review payload, saved decisions, applied decisions and model-data report if present. Exact lineage maps predecessor paths/hashes to registered input IDs. Existing author context exposes confirmed question, new initial draft/schemas and paths/hashes of these selected originals, whole within 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes or refused. Actual subsequent model reads may include client facts and declared reviewer names/notes; no anonymization or local-only guarantee. Private unsent follow-up fields remain app-private. Historical acceptance does not confirm the new case; saved public choices may postdate the applied record. Permission or a copied prompt does not prove any read. These optional native model routes are OpenAI-specific; ordinary Cowork connected-file work remains independent. App-private metadata placement depends on actual installed-host handling and does not promise local-only model processing.
classes.purpose: Rework an explicitly authorized literal question in a new run from exact historical workpapers and separately selected engagement evidence

classes.content: The exact owned run/revision/inventory/document selection returns the full prepared ordinary extracted text, document relative path and source/extraction hashes/status/limitations, within 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes or refuses without truncation. Original absolute paths, unsent initial date/client/language/jurisdiction drafts and opaque persistence authority are excluded. The private extraction/output view is bounded to 2000000 bytes; no OCR, source fetch or model-weights download occurs in native initialization. The text is untrusted and actual original/visual/model reading is not attested. Real case facts may enter the chosen account; no anonymization or local-only guarantee.
classes.purpose: Discuss one explicitly selected complete original-derived extraction without adopting unsent initial parameters

de: Die private Verfahrensakte und alle für ihre Vorbereitung nützlichen Daten können das Modell erreichen.

Dazu können Dokumente, Personen- oder Firmenname, Steuernummer, Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer, Anschriften, E-Mail, PEC, Telefon, zuständige Kammer, Rechtsform, Tätigkeit und ATECO, Ämter und Positionen, noch nicht veröffentlichte Änderungen, Wirksamkeitsdaten, vorgeschlagene Werte für DIRE-Felder, Belegauszüge, Risiken und fehlende Informationen gehören.

Nach der Zuordnung wiederholt das Prüfungspaket nicht den gesamten Identitätsblock; es behält Verfahrenszweck, vorgeschlagene Einzelwerte, Belegauszüge, Risiken und fehlende Informationen. Spätere Phasen verwenden eine temporäre, an Run und Hash gebundene Referenz; die öffentliche SARI-Suche läuft nur bei verfügbarem Web- oder Browserzugriff und blockiert exakte Identitätswerte aus dem Fall; andernfalls werden bereitgestellte offizielle Quellen verwendet und die aktuelle Quellenabdeckung als unvollständig gekennzeichnet.

Es erfolgt keine automatische Anonymisierung.
en: The private practice file and all information useful for preparing it can reach the model.

This can include documents, personal or company name, tax code, VAT number, addresses, email, PEC, telephone, competent Chamber, legal form, activity and ATECO, offices and positions, changes not yet public, effective dates, proposed DIRE field values, evidence extracts, risks, and missing information.

After mapping, the review package does not repeat the entire client-identity block; it keeps the case purpose, individual proposed values, evidence extracts, risks, and missing information. Later phases reuse a temporary run- and hash-bound reference, and public SARI search runs only when web or browser access is available and blocks exact identity values already present in the case; otherwise supplied official sources are used and current-source coverage is marked incomplete.

No automatic anonymization is applied.
es: El expediente privado del trámite y todos los datos útiles para prepararlo pueden llegar al modelo.

Esto puede incluir documentos, nombre personal o razón social, código fiscal, número de IVA, direcciones, correo electrónico, PEC, teléfono, Cámara competente, forma jurídica, actividad y ATECO, cargos y posiciones, cambios aún no públicos, fechas de efecto, valores propuestos para los campos DIRE, extractos probatorios, riesgos e información faltante.

Después del mapeo, el paquete de revisión no repite todo el bloque de identidad del cliente; conserva el propósito, los valores propuestos, los extractos probatorios, los riesgos y la información faltante. Las fases posteriores reutilizan una referencia temporal vinculada al run y al hash; la búsqueda pública SARI también bloquea valores de identidad exactos ya presentes en el expediente.

No se aplica anonimización automática.
fr: Le dossier privé de la formalité et toutes les données utiles à sa préparation peuvent parvenir au modèle.

Cela peut inclure les documents, le nom de la personne ou de l’entreprise, le code fiscal, le numéro de TVA, les adresses, l’email, la PEC, le téléphone, la Chambre compétente, la forme juridique, l’activité et le code ATECO, les fonctions et positions, les modifications non encore publiques, les dates d’effet, les valeurs proposées pour les champs DIRE, les extraits probants, les risques et les informations manquantes.

Après la cartographie, le paquet de revue ne répète pas tout le bloc d’identité client; il conserve l’objet du dossier, les valeurs proposées, les extraits probants, les risques et les informations manquantes. Les étapes suivantes réutilisent une référence temporaire liée au run et au hachage; la recherche SARI publique n’a lieu que si l’accès web ou navigateur est disponible et bloque les valeurs d’identité exactes déjà présentes dans le dossier ; sinon les sources officielles fournies sont utilisées et la couverture actuelle est signalée comme incomplète.

Aucune anonymisation automatique n’est appliquée.
it: Il fascicolo privato della pratica e tutti i dati utili alla compilazione possono arrivare al modello.

Possono comprendere documenti, nome o ragione sociale, codice fiscale, partita IVA, indirizzi, email, PEC, telefono, Camera competente, forma giuridica, attività e ATECO, cariche e posizioni, modifiche non ancora pubbliche, date di efficacia, valori proposti per i campi DIRE, estratti probatori, rischi e informazioni mancanti.

Dopo la mappatura, il pacchetto di revisione non ripete l’intero blocco identità cliente: conserva scopo della pratica, singoli valori proposti, estratti probatori, rischi e informazioni mancanti. Le fasi successive riusano un riferimento temporaneo legato al run e all’hash; la ricerca SARI pubblica avviene solo quando web o browser sono disponibili e blocca i valori identificativi esatti già presenti nel fascicolo; altrimenti usa fonti ufficiali fornite e segnala la copertura corrente come incompleta.

Non viene applicata un’anonimizzazione automatica.

security_controls.control: Public initialization and conservation require the digest-valid running Studio Archive registro-imprese-sari context and exact input/output roots. Optional native authoring exercises unchanged public producers only in a fixed isolated private preview; adoption writes the exact current run. Selected original-copy IDs, paths and hashes are checked against the mandate and registered context; no native source fetch or OCR download.
Case and review validators reject credential, authentication-token, cookie, signature, and session-material fields before persistence.

The review package omits the wholesale client_identity object after its required values have been mapped into proposed filing fields, while retaining case purpose, proposals, evidence extracts, risks, and missing information; persisted MCP phases reuse a four-hour run- and hash-bound opaque reference instead of retransmitting those private rows.

Before the optional public SARI connector transmits a query, it rejects both mechanically recognizable identifier formats and exact values already recorded as the case client reference or client identity; it does not attempt semantic PII classification.

The optional local browser transport binds only to 127.0.0.1 on an OS-selected port and secret path, rejects foreign Host/Origin and non-JSON writes, exposes only the existing save/apply operations for one exact run-bound opaque token, and reuses native ownership/hash/lifecycle validation. Archived cases render read-only; native writes still require a running run. No remote assets or data transfer are introduced.

Owned shared initialization and ordinary inventory use selected Archive originals and no OCR or network. Initial date/reference/language/jurisdiction drafts stay app-private, generation-bound and separately confirmed; they do not become classifications or legal decisions. One explicit complete extracted text may reach the selected host model with byte identity and limitations. Absolute original paths and unsent initial fields are excluded; actual model reads and complete initial source/plan authoring remain unverified. Candidate shared UI syntax and closure corrections are separately qualified; canonical application and actual host acceptance remain pending.

Actor/tenant/client/engagement/run scoped private question, draft CAS, confirmed mandate and preserved initial-output snapshot. Model cannot attest professional confirmations. Complete preview and public audit stay private; signed adoption binds exact stage, current outputs and selected original hashes, requires every proposed source explicitly chosen, an actual declared selector and renewed confirmation. Mechanical preflight rejects ordinary invalid proposals before creating a write intent. Uncertain intents and open mandates block output closure. Actual registry filing, professional-review completion, model reads and installed-host acceptance remain unverified; candidate shared UI/closure API corrections are qualified separately but canonical application remains pending.

Exact owned running reviewer scope, signed review/source binding, literal draft CAS and renewed separate Save/Apply confirmations. Mechanical invalid-choice checking through unchanged public producer occurs without persistence authority before retaining an intent. Fixed public validate/render/token/save/apply retain actual client engagement context. Prior mutable public records and exact operation receipts remain private; pending/orphaned operations or altered snapshots block writes and closure. No case/plan/checklist/question rewriting or filing authority. Candidate shared UI/closure/ticket corrections are separately qualified, unapproved and unapplied; no installed-host acceptance.

Distinct same-client/engagement/workflow run, whole predecessor SHA snapshot, explicit extra imported receipt choices, saved literal parameters and renewed creation/initialization/model mandate confirmation. Existing public initializer and proposal producer remain authoritative; all new professional confirmations stay pending. Preserve old output bytes/run record, exact registered history mapping, origin marker and whole immutable receipt. Pending/orphan/changed history blocks source and successor use and closure. Candidate source input tuple/list scope normalization is separately qualified but unapplied; real installed host acceptance remains unverified.
